versions.changelog:
- Added concise English description to the SKILL.md front matter, making the skill more accessible to non-Chinese users.
- No functional changes to code or APIs; documentation only.

- 新增登录与API密钥管理功能，包含 LOGIN.md、login.py 和 utils.py 文件
- 支持扫描二维码手机登录九马AI平台，突破免费生成次数限制
- 文档增加 FreeApiLimit 错误说明与完整的登录和API密钥获取流程指引
- 可自动保存API密钥，达到免费限额后无需重复登录
- 故障排除与使用提示更加详细，提升用户体验

jiuma-free-image-gen 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for free text-to-image generation using the Jiuma AI API.
- Supports customizable image size up to 832x832, customizable prompt, and simple command-line interface.
- Allows querying task status after submission to check image generation progress and download results.
- No API key required, with free-tier limitations (output size, queueing at high load).
- Includes clear API usage examples, error troubleshooting, and prompt crafting tips.
